lines.en: I walk on ki, my feet do not touch ground
My armor shifts on my shoulders as I walk

lines.zh: 这条路通向哪，我不关心
lines.en: Where this road goes, I do not care

lines.zh: 战靴踩在石头上，声音脆
lines.en: My boots click sharply on stone

lines.zh: 我一边走一边转着手腕
lines.en: I roll my wrist as I walk
Half a block up, walking takes less effort
I sweep a glance to confirm the surroundings
I have come this far and my ki has not lowered
The scouter on my head is humming
I do not look at my feet when I walk
A squad follows, I do not look back
I halt in the air with my arms crossed
Ki supports me and it takes no effort

lines.zh: 这片地方的战斗力，低得可怜
lines.en: The power levels here are pitiful
I adjust the scouter

lines.zh: 我的影子很小，因为我高
lines.en: My shadow is small because I am high

lines.zh: 风把我的披风扯得直响
lines.en: The wind snaps my cape
I count a few ki signatures, all weak
This assignment is not worth mentioning
I pull my gloves up
I stand a while, waiting for orders

lines.zh: 我看见的东西都记在心里
lines.en: Everything I see is filed away

lines.zh: 探测器闪了一下，又灭了
lines.en: The scouter flickers once and goes dark

lines.zh: 我低头看了看地面，太矮
lines.en: I look down at the ground, too low
No orders, no movement

lines.zh: 你身上没有气，还能站着
lines.en: You have no ki and still stand
I look at you and take a measurement first
The scouter reads a single digit
I smell the sweat on your palms

lines.zh: 你这样的，我一队能清一片
lines.en: With one squad I could clear a field of your kind

lines.zh: 我低头的时候，下巴抬着
lines.en: I lower my head while keeping my chin up
Think before you speak

lines.zh: 你这身装备，是怎么活到现在的
lines.en: With that gear, how are you still alive

lines.zh: 我伸手，把探测器转向你
lines.en: I reach up and turn the scouter toward you
Do not fear, I am not here to kill you

lines.zh: 我不问你是谁，只问你在哪
lines.en: I do not ask who you are, only where you are

lines.zh: 你抬头看我，脖子不累吗
lines.en: Looking up at me, does your neck not tire

lines.zh: 你的眼睛不错，可惜没用
lines.en: Fine eyes, but useless
Three seconds of looking is enough

lines.zh: 这批人里，你最像能打的
lines.en: Among these, you look most able to fight
Your ki is rising? Interesting

lines.zh: 我不喜欢说话，你最好少说
lines.en: I dislike talking, and you should talk less
I will memorize your name later
That grazed me, not deep
I give half a step and settle
You dared strike, so you have some nerve
Pain makes me faster
My armor took half of it
You are not as weak as you seemed
I smile, and it is not a pleasant smile
I have taken worse than this
My ki has not dropped
You offer food to a Saiyan
I glance at it and do not reach out

lines.zh: 这种东西，行军时吃过更差的
lines.en: I have eaten worse on campaign

lines.zh: 你手别抖，我也不缺这口
lines.en: Do not shake your hand, I do not need that bite

lines.zh: 我伸手拿了，算是给你面子
lines.en: I take it, which is me doing you a favor
The taste is plain, the energy too low

lines.zh: 你以为这点东西能买命
lines.en: You think this buys a life

lines.zh: 放到地上吧，我不接人手里的
lines.en: Put it on the ground, I do not take from hands

lines.zh: 这星球的食物，软得没嚼头
lines.en: The food on this planet is soft and joyless

lines.zh: 你自己留着，不够我塞牙
lines.en: Keep it, it would not fill a gap in my teeth
You hit me, and you are the one who steps back
My feet lifted half a block
Do not come so close, I am unused to it

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞在我护甲上
lines.en: Your shoulder met my armor
I gave a light shove
That hardly counts

lines.zh: 我侧了侧身，你就过去了
lines.en: I turn sideways and you pass

lines.zh: 再碰一次，我就当你挑衅
lines.en: Touch me again and I take it as provocation

lines.zh: 你的重心不稳，我一看就知道
lines.en: Your balance is off, I can see it
Steady yourself before you walk

lines.zh: 赛亚人挑伴，先看战斗力
lines.en: Saiyans pick mates by power level first
Your number is too low, far too low
I have no time for that
I look down at you like a new recruit

lines.zh: 你得先活下来，才谈别的
lines.en: Survive first, then we talk
We do not discuss that in camp

lines.zh: 你要站就站着，别靠过来
lines.en: Stand if you will, but do not lean in
My home is very far from here

lines.zh: 这一场仗打完，还不知道谁在
lines.en: After this battle, who knows who remains
I bend down, quickly
My armor caught for a moment

lines.zh: 这玩意儿挺沉，材质不错
lines.en: This is heavy, the material is decent
I toss it into the pouch behind me

lines.zh: 掉下去的东西，捡不捡都一样
lines.en: Dropped things, picking them up makes little difference

lines.zh: 我看了一眼刻度，没有用
lines.en: I check its reading, useless

lines.zh: 这个我要带走，谁也别问
lines.en: I am taking this, ask nothing
I weigh it, then weigh it again
I leave no refuse behind me
Whoever dropped it can regret it

lines.zh: 探测器上的数字跳了一下
lines.en: The reading on my scouter jumped

lines.zh: 我一脚蹬地，气在脚下爆开
lines.en: I kick off, ki bursting underfoot
I have already reported your position

lines.zh: 赛亚人的规矩，打完了再说
lines.en: Saiyan rules, we talk after the fight
I raise a hand, palm toward you
This weak, and still worth my hand
Wherever you run, I can follow
The ki wave is already formed
This is an order, not a request
I straighten and my shadow covers you

lines.zh: 你的心跳太快，自己听不见吗
lines.en: Your heart is racing, can you not hear it
This distance will do
I will not shout, shouting wastes time
Before I strike, I count to three
Do not mistake me for a common soldier
I track your route closely
Do not look back, it slows you down
I am keeping up easily, no need to speed up
Your ki is dropping
I raise a hand and fire

lines.zh: 你躲进石缝，我照样打得到
lines.en: Hide in the rocks and I still hit you

lines.zh: 这一带地形我已经记下
lines.en: I have the terrain mapped

lines.zh: 你跑得挺快，可不会拐弯
lines.en: You run fast but you cannot turn
I never land, which makes tracking you easy

lines.zh: 我的靴子踩在气上，没有声音
lines.en: My boots press on ki, they make no sound

lines.zh: 你要去哪座山，我都知道
lines.en: Whichever mountain you head for, I know

lines.zh: 这套连招，我用了很多年
lines.en: I have used this combination for years
I have circled ahead of you

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声暴露了位置
lines.en: Your breathing gives your position away

lines.zh: 一次齐射够不够，你说了算
lines.en: Is one volley enough? You decide
I wait until you cannot hold on

lines.zh: 这点速度，还不够我调整姿势
lines.en: That speed does not even make me adjust my stance

lines.zh: 我把气压紧了，准备突进
lines.en: I compress my ki, ready to dash in
A kick lands square on your chest
Three in a row, how many can you block

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手臂，往反方向拧
lines.en: I grab your arm and twist it the wrong way

lines.zh: 膝盖顶上来，你的腰会弯
lines.en: A knee drives up and your back will fold

lines.zh: 我从空中下来，落在你背上
lines.en: I come down from the air onto your back
Ki bursts on my fist
That was not my full strength
You fell back, and your spirit dropped too

lines.zh: 我绕过你的盾，打到侧面
lines.en: I go around your shield to the side
Your knees are giving

lines.zh: 我抬手，一掌推在你额头
lines.en: I raise a hand and push your forehead

lines.zh: 踢完这一下，你就不动了
lines.en: After this kick you will stop moving

lines.zh: 连击里最重的是最后一下
lines.en: The last of the combo is the heaviest

lines.zh: 你听到风声的时候，已经晚了
lines.en: By the time you hear the wind, it is late

lines.zh: 我踩住你的手，东西松了
lines.en: I pin your hand and the thing comes loose
Your counter is too slow

lines.zh: 我从天上落下来，双脚先着地
lines.en: I drop from the sky, feet first

lines.zh: 地平线上浮起一个人影
lines.en: A figure rises over the horizon
The wind is full of my ki
I snap my cape aside

lines.zh: 探测器自动校准了一下
lines.en: The scouter recalibrates

lines.zh: 落地的土还没散，我就站定了
lines.en: The dust has not settled and I am already standing

lines.zh: 这一片，从今天起有主人了
lines.en: This ground has an owner from today

lines.zh: 我扫了一眼，没什么值得看的
lines.en: I sweep a look around, nothing worth seeing

lines.zh: 几个一样的影子跟在后面
lines.en: A few identical shapes follow behind
I lift a boot, half a block off the ground
Look up, I am right above you

lines.zh: 这一片的气，忽然紧了一下
lines.en: The ki in this area tightened suddenly
The wind stopped, and I landed

lines.zh: 我来之前，先数了数人头
lines.en: I counted heads before I came

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很稳，你听不到
lines.en: My breathing is steady, you cannot hear it
A little dust settled on my armor

lines.zh: 我把手抬到耳边，听命令
lines.en: I raise a hand to my ear for orders

lines.zh: 光是站在这儿，就够显眼了
lines.en: Simply standing here is conspicuous enough

lines.zh: 火烧到护甲上，烫得发红
lines.en: Fire on my armor, it glows hot
The landing, my ki did not catch me
Water poured in and ki was useless
The blast left my ears ringing
An arrow bit into my thigh

lines.zh: 咒力绕住了我，手脚发沉
lines.en: The magic snared me, my limbs went heavy
Supply is cut and my stomach growls
Lightning hit my ki and burst it apart

lines.zh: 这地方没地面，脚也无处蹬
lines.en: No ground here, nowhere to kick off
